A '''Weequay''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and a crew member of a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] pirate ship, the [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)/Legends|''Marauder'']].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] and a [[Unidentified Weequay (Balnab)|fellow one]] landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]] and found a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-Wing]] starfighter and two deactivated droids, [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. The Weequays then brought the droids aboard their ship to use as entertainment for gladiatorial droid fights.

However, their ship, the [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)/Legends|''Marauder'']], was detected by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]] who ordered that their ship be used as target practice and opened fire from his [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer|Providence-class carrier/destroyer]]. The ''Marauder'' was eventually destroyed and all the occupants, including this Weequay, were [[Death/Legends|killed]].
